title: 第五章 太素银针第六章 改稻为药
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: 他按照师父的指点，一个月去红袖招听一次小曲儿，放松身心。
而后便是每日刻苦练功，增加的进度也是弄了个明白。
一张一弛，半个月能增加一点进度！
一年便是二十四点，这样算来，他只需要四年多一点便能修炼到大成地步！
倒也不慢。
“师父你真是五年多才练成的？”
李水生有些不信。
杜大夫躺在藤椅上晒太阳，“我那时并不像你，每日练功不停，偶尔也放纵一段时间。”
李水生很快明白了其中的差距。
师父可没有办法时时刻刻看到自己的增长。
一个人辛辛苦苦练功一两年，却感觉不到自己的实力进步，是很正常的事。
辛苦一两年，没有明显进步，自然会放纵懈怠一段时间。
但他不一样，他能清楚看到自己的进步，故而每一天都极为认真。
这便是面板带来的好处了。
秋高气爽，晨起时屋檐上的白霜一片。
这一日午时，李水生看完最后一本医书，合上了书页。
再看自己的面板：
凡俗医术：医师（1100）
师父的医术，他已经完全继承了。
屋内传来师父的呼喊声，“水生，我想吃阳春面了。”
李水生只觉得毛骨悚然。
师父说过的：他母亲临死之前，给他和父亲做了一碗阳春面。
从那以后，师父便不再吃面了。
他快步走进院子，只见杜大夫眼中闪烁着不属于这个年纪的亢奋。
“我这就去买。”
他刚走出医馆，便听见背后师父的呼喊，“水生！”
“怎么了？”
“不要蛋，清汤，不要葱。”
李水生快步走向王叔的铺子，“王叔，一碗阳春面，不要蛋不要葱，清汤，快！”
“我怕师父要等不及了！”
李水生很快带着面回来，杜大夫吃了一口，不自觉眼角溢出泪来。
他又吃了三大口，第三口只吃了一半，便仰躺在藤椅上，不再动了。
李水生试探着感受师父的鼻息。
下一刻，他爆发出哭嚎声来。
“师父！”
杜大夫走了，时年八十四岁。
content_en:
Following his master's instructions, he went to Hongxiuzhao once a month to listen to small songs to relax his body and mind.
Then I practiced hard every day, and I figured out the progress of the increase.
One by one, you can make a little progress in half a month!
One year is twenty-four points. Calculating this, it only takes a little more than four years for him to practice to the point of great success!
Not too slow.
"Master, it really took you more than five years to practice?"
Li Shuisheng didn't believe it.
Doctor Du was lying on a wicker chair basking in the sun, "I was not like you at that time. I practiced Qigong non-stop every day, and occasionally indulged for a while."
Li Shuisheng quickly understood the difference.
There is no way for Master to see his own growth all the time.
It is normal for a person to practice hard for a year or two but not feel that his strength has improved.
If you work hard for a year or two and make no significant progress, you will naturally indulge and slack off for a period of time.
But he is different. He can clearly see his progress, so he takes it extremely seriously every day.
This is the benefit of the panel.
The autumn air is crisp and crisp, and when I wake up in the morning, there is a patch of white frost on the eaves.
At noon that day, Li Shuisheng finished reading the last medical book and closed the page.
Look at your own panel again:
Mortal Medical Skills: Physician (1100)
He has completely inherited his master's medical skills.
Master's call came from inside the room, "Shui Sheng, I want to eat Yangchun noodles."
Li Shuisheng only felt creepy.
Master said: Before his mother died, she made him and his father a bowl of Yangchun noodles.
From then on, Master stopped eating noodles.
He walked quickly into the courtyard and saw Doctor Du's eyes flashing with excitement that was not for his age.
"I'll buy it right now."
As soon as he walked out of the hospital, he heard the master's call from behind, "Shui Sheng!"
"What's wrong?"
"No eggs, clear soup, no green onions."
Li Shuisheng walked quickly to Uncle Wang's shop, "Uncle Wang, a bowl of Yangchun noodles, no eggs, no green onions, clear soup, hurry up!"
"I'm afraid Master won't be able to wait any longer!"
Li Shuisheng came back soon with noodles. Doctor Du took a bite and tears overflowed from the corners of his eyes unconsciously.
He took three more big bites, and after eating only half of the third bite, he lay back on the wicker chair and stopped moving.
Li Shuisheng tentatively felt the master's breath.
The next moment, he burst out crying.
"Master!"
Doctor Du passed away at the age of eighty-four.
